title: "Final Intercoder Reliability"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(irr)
```

```{r}
# Read raw data file into data frame
data_raw <- read_excel("C:/Users/10845/OneDrive/Desktop/FinalSample.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# Delete unecessary lines and replace Yes/No with 1/0
data <- data_raw |>
  select(-(1:17)) |> 
  mutate(across(Q7:Q17, ~ ifelse(. == "Yes", 1, 0))) |> 
  slice(-1) |> 
  rename("Review_ID" = Q4,
         "Coder" = Q1,
         "Category" = Q2,
         "Genre" = Q3,
         "Post Date" = Q6,
         "Played Hours" = Q5,
         "Coder Remark" = Q20)
```


```{r}
# Extract data for intercoder reliability testing
intercoder_df <- data |> 
  filter(grepl("_(10|[1-9])$", `Review_ID`)) |> 
  select(-2,-3,-5,-6,-18) |> 
  mutate(Coder = recode(Coder,
                        "Xinran" = 4,
                        "Qi" = 3,
                        "Helmi" = 2,
                        "Fion" = 1))
```


```{r}
# Turn the data format into long
long_data <- intercoder_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = Q7:Q17,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

sum(is.na(long_data))
```

```{r}
World_Design <- long_data |>
  filter(variable == "Q7") |>
  select(Review_ID, Coder, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Coder, values_from = value)
View(World_Design)

kripp.alpha(t(as.matrix(World_Design[,-1])), method = "nominal")
```

```{r}
results <- list()

for (v in unique(long_data$variable)) {

  temp <- long_data |>
    filter(variable == v) |>
    select(Review_ID, Coder, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Coder, values_from = value)

  alpha <- kripp.alpha(t(as.matrix(temp[,-1])), method = "nominal")

  results[[v]] <- alpha$value
}

results
```
